description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the class ImmutableFunctionExpression in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.placeholders package. It tests immutability, equals and hashCode, supported function names, handling of unknown functions, specific function implementations such as upper, lower, default, substring-before, substring-after, and filter, and their correct resolution behavior.
